_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: White sectional garage door on a modest Florida home
figures.caption: Confirm opening dimensions, headroom, side room, and the condition of the jambs before ordering a replacement. The door system must fit the actual opening and its support conditions.

figures.alt: Garage-door roller seated in a hinge track detail
figures.caption: Inspect rollers, hinges, tracks, and brackets before assuming a new panel solves the problem. Spring and counterbalance work remains a professional safety task.

figures.alt: Garage door meeting a clean bottom seal at a concrete slab
figures.caption: Finish by checking the bottom seal, slab contact, photo-eyes, and full travel. A replacement should close evenly without scraping, binding, or leaving a weather gap.
